svg.text: Miners' Camp: campfire, sacks, crates, wall torches, graffiti.
Haulage Gallery: ore cart, crates, lantern post, rubble,
Supply Cellar: crates, barrels, sacks, rats.
Guard Post: table & stools, barrels, skeletons, wall torches,
A leads down to Level 2: stone arch, rickety rope bridge, 2 landings, ladder,
wooden stair, stone ledge, portcullis. Rats lurk along the way.
Web-choked Den: giant spider, scattered bones, chest, thick
Glimmering Cave: glowing crystals, giant mushrooms,
A comes up from Level 1, through a portcullis.
B leads down to Level 3: stone arch, flight of stairs, 3 landings, rickety rope
bridge, ladder, open archway. Rats and goblins lurk along the way.
Drowned Gallery: drowned dead, stalagmites, chest, bats.
Slime Pit: 2 oozes, scattered bones, coin heap, stalagmites.
Black Pool: drowned dead, stalagmites, chest, bats.
B comes up from Level 2, through an open archway.
Dwarven workings abandoned when the deep water rose
Each level is a cutaway slice of earth; front walls removed. One flagstone is about 5 ft. Lettered diamonds mark where the ways between levels begin and end.
